create:
hormuz --config config.example.json policy create \
  --template standard \
  --organization xpounder \
  --monthly-budget-usd 500 \
  --per-actor-monthly-budget-usd 50 \
  --output agency-baseline.json
team:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path

policy = json.loads(Path("agency-baseline.json").read_text())
policy["policies"]["teams"]["engineering"] = {
    "monthly_budget_usd": 300,
    "max_output_tokens": 2000,
}
with Path("agency-team.json").open("x") as target:
    target.write(json.dumps(policy, indent=2) + "\n")
PY

hormuz --config config.example.json policy validate agency-team.json
compare:
if hormuz --config config.example.json policy compare agency-team.json \
  --baseline agency-baseline.json \
  --organization xpounder \
  --json > agency-comparison.json; then
  printf 'Policies are identical.\n'
else
  comparison_status=$?
  if [ "$comparison_status" -ne 1 ]; then
    exit "$comparison_status"
  fi
  printf 'Expected result: the candidate differs from the baseline.\n'
fi
cat agency-comparison.json
report:
hormuz --config /etc/hormuz/hormuz.json status --group-by team
hormuz --config /etc/hormuz/hormuz.json status --group-by person --team engineering
hormuz --config /etc/hormuz/hormuz.json status --group-by model --team engineering
